# Orbita

> Orbita discovers, inventories and risk-scores every AI agent, automation, custom GPT and MCP server running in a company. Security teams use it to assign owners, revoke orphaned agents, and export DPDP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and EU AI Act evidence. No SDK. Read-only connectors. India data residency by default.

Orbita is an AI agent discovery and governance platform for mid-market security teams, built in India. It is not a CASB or a CSPM: those tools inspect SaaS traffic and cloud configs. Orbita maps non-human identities by reading OAuth grants, audit logs, DNS egress and behavioral fingerprints.

Optional: [pricing.md](https://www.orbita.io/pricing.md), [llms-full.txt](https://www.orbita.io/llms-full.txt)
